items.title: Enterprise Analytics Platform

overview: [PLACEHOLDER] Architecture and design of a high-scale dashboard servicing distributed telemetry.

purpose: [PLACEHOLDER] Enable real-time visibility into mission-critical business metrics with sub-second refresh rates.
